_note: Week of October 19–25, 2026. Keto week: 20 g NET carbs per day for each of you, so every 'carbs' value in this file is net carbs (total carbs minus fiber) and the carbs goal is 20. Protein targets are unchanged; fat fills the rest of the calories. Standing structure kept: Monday no fish, Tuesday leftover-plus-treat (pork + shrimp lettuce wraps), Wednesday and Friday fish, Jake's 5-container Sunday batch lunch, Laine's cold tuna jar. The vegetarian Saturday and breakfast-for-dinner Sunday are paused this week. Jake eats breakfast with Laine on Saturday and Sunday (see the Weekend tab). Shakes use almond milk. Cauliflower rice replaces quinoa; no lemon-garlic flavoring anywhere this week. No raw onion, mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, farro, or paneer.

tzatziki.name: Dill Sour Cream Sauce
tzatziki.note: This week's sauce card, for Wednesday's salmon. Mild, cool, and no lemon or garlic. Makes enough for both plates (about 50 g sour cream total). Keeps 3 days; also good on Thursday's meatballs or the Sunday steak.
tzatziki.macrosNote: Per ~2 tbsp serving (30 g sour cream plus dill).

ingredients.item: Sour cream — 50 g total (about 3 tbsp)
Fresh dill — 7 g, finely chopped
Salt and black pepper — to taste

steps: Stir the sour cream and chopped dill together with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Thin with a teaspoon of water until it is spoonable.
Chill 10 min before serving.

dinners.name: Pork Medallions in Dijon Cream + Roasted Zucchini
dinners.note: Sear medallions, pan sauce of Dijon + cream + butter. Cook about 580 g pork total; Tuesday uses 150 g of it.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 280 g, Laine 150 g raw
Heavy cream — Jake 2 ½ tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1 ½ tsp
Butter — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 ½ tsp
Zucchini — Jake 130 g, Laine 130 g
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¾ tsp, Laine 1 tsp

steps: Slice the pork tenderloin into 1-inch medallions. Season with salt, pepper, and a little paprika. Cook all of it tonight (about 580 g raw); Tuesday's tacos use 150 g.
Toss zucchini planks with half the olive oil and the parmesan. Roast at 425°F for 15–18 min until golden at the edges.
Sear the pork in the remaining olive oil 2–3 min per side to 145°F. Rest 5 min. Set Tuesday's portion aside to cool and refrigerate.
Pan sauce: lower the heat, add butter, Dijon, and cream to the same pan. Simmer 2 min until it coats a spoon. Spoon over the pork. Jake gets the bigger portion.

dinners.name: Leftover Pork + Shrimp Lettuce-Wrap Tacos
dinners.note: Leftover-plus-treat night: Monday's pork sliced and crisped, plus lime-seasoned shrimp. No raw onion; tomato pico only. Mild.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 100 g, Laine 50 g raw
Frozen shrimp — Jake 150 g, Laine 80 g raw
Romaine lettuce — Jake 80 g, Laine 70 g
Avocado — Jake 60 g, Laine 60 g
Sour cream — Jake 1 ½ tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Lime juice — Jake 1 ½ tsp, Laine 1 ¼ tsp
Cherry tomatoes — Jake 20 g, Laine 25 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ½ tbsp, Laine 2 ½ tsp
Seasoning (salt, pepper, paprika) — Jake ¾ tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 3 g, Laine 2 g
Butter — Jake 1 ¾ tsp

steps: Slice Monday's pork thin. Warm in a hot pan with half the olive oil and the taco seasoning until the edges crisp, 3–4 min.
Pat the shrimp dry, season lightly, and sear in the remaining olive oil and butter 1–2 min per side until just pink. Finish with a squeeze of the lime juice.
Avocado-lime crema: mash the avocado with the sour cream and the rest of the lime juice until smooth. Fold in chopped cilantro.
Dice the tomato for a no-onion pico with cilantro and a pinch of salt.
Fill romaine leaves with pork and shrimp, then crema and pico. Jake gets more of both proteins.

dinners.name: Creamy Dill Salmon + Roasted Asparagus
dinners.note: Fish night. Bake salmon 12 to 14 min at 400F; spoon over dill-sour cream sauce.

ingredients.item: Atlantic salmon — Jake 250 g, Laine 140 g raw
Sour cream — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 4 g, Laine 3 g
Butter — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 ¼ tsp
Asparagus — Jake 150 g, Laine 120 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¾ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss asparagus with half the olive oil and the parmesan; roast 10–12 min.
Pat salmon dry, season with salt and pepper, brush with the remaining olive oil. Roast skin-side down 12–14 min until just opaque and flaky.
Stir the sour cream with chopped dill and a splash of water to a spoonable sauce (see the sauce card).
Melt the butter over the salmon as it rests, then spoon over the dill sauce. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Turkey Meatballs in Parmesan Cream + Zucchini Noodles
dinners.note: Meatballs bound with parmesan, egg and a little almond flour; simmer in cream sauce. Onion cooked in. Mild.

ingredients.item: Ground turkey 93/7 — Jake 280 g, Laine 120 g raw
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 4 tbsp, Laine 2 ½ tbsp
Eggs — Jake ½ eggs, Laine ½ eggs
Almond flour — Jake 10 g, Laine 8 g
Heavy cream — Jake 2 ½ tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Zucchini — Jake 100 g, Laine 120 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 6 g, Laine 8 g
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 3 g, Laine 2 g

steps: Mix turkey, half the parmesan, the egg, almond flour, and a pinch of salt. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Brown in the olive oil over medium-high heat 5–6 min, turning, then lower the heat and cover 6–8 min until cooked through (165°F).
Push meatballs aside, cook the onion in the pan 2–3 min until soft. Add the cream and remaining parmesan; simmer 2–3 min.
Spiralize or peel the zucchini into noodles; toss in the hot sauce 1 min until just tender (don't overcook). Finish with parsley. Mild throughout.

dinners.name: Parmesan-Herb Baked Cod + Cauliflower Mash
dinners.note: Fish night. Top cod with butter, parmesan and herbs, then bake. Mash steamed cauliflower with cream cheese and butter.

ingredients.item: Frozen cod — Jake 330 g, Laine 180 g raw
Butter — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 3 tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 4 g, Laine 3 g
Cauliflower — Jake 120 g, Laine 100 g
Cream cheese — Jake 1 ½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 1 tsp

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Steam the cauliflower 10–12 min until very tender.
Pat cod dry. Top with the butter, parmesan, and chopped parsley. Bake 12–15 min until it flakes.
Blend or mash the cauliflower with cream cheese, a little butter, and salt until smooth. Drizzle with olive oil.
Plate cod over the mash. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Roasted Chicken Thighs with Herb Butter + Green Beans
dinners.note: Roast thighs at 425F; finish with herb butter. Toss green beans in butter. Mild.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 320 g, Laine 150 g raw
Butter — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 2 ¼ tsp
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 3 g, Laine 2 g
Green beans — Jake 90 g, Laine 80 g
Avocado — Jake 60 g, Laine 80 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¼ tsp, Laine 1 ¼ tsp
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Seasoning (salt, pepper, paprika) — Jake 0.4 tsp, Laine 0.4 tsp

steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Pat thighs dry, rub with olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika. Roast 25–30 min until 175°F.
Mash the butter with chopped parsley and thyme to make herb butter.
Sauté green beans in a little butter 6–8 min until crisp-tender. Sprinkle with parmesan.
Rest the chicken 5 min, top with herb butter, and serve with sliced avocado.

dinners.name: Seared Sirloin with Herb Butter + Creamed Spinach
dinners.note: Sear steak 3 to 4 min per side. Creamed spinach: cream, parmesan, onion cooked in. Mild.

ingredients.item: Sirloin steak — Jake 280 g, Laine 150 g raw
Butter — Jake 2 ¼ tsp, Laine 2 ¼ tsp
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — Jake 3 g, Laine 2 g
Baby spinach — Jake 100 g, Laine 100 g
Heavy cream — Jake 2 ½ tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 ½ tbsp
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 5 g, Laine 5 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 ¾ tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Pull the steak out 20 min before cooking; pat dry and season well with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with half the olive oil 3–4 min per side for medium-rare (Laine's can go a touch longer). Add herb butter in the last minute. Rest 5 min.
Creamed spinach: cook the onion in the remaining olive oil 2–3 min until soft, add spinach to wilt, then cream and parmesan; simmer 3 min.
Slice the steak against the grain. Mild seasoning; Jake can add pepper at the table.

jakeLunch.name: Creamy Smoked-Paprika Chicken Thighs + Broccoli Cauli-Rice
jakeLunch.note: Keto batch bowl, same 5-container Sunday format. Chicken thighs cooked in a cream-parmesan paprika sauce so they stay moist through 5 days of reheating. Broccoli and cauliflower rice stand in for quinoa. No spinach, no fish, no garnish that fades. Cauliflower rice is raw-weight; steam it in the container when reheating.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — 1200 g raw total (240 g per container)
Heavy cream — 15 tbsp total (3 tbsp per container)
Parmesan cheese, grated — 15 tbsp total (3 tbsp per container)
Olive oil — 6 ½ tbsp total (1 ½ tbsp per container)
Yellow onion (cooked in) — 50 g total (10 g per container)
Seasoning (salt, pepper, paprika) — 5 tsp total (1 tsp per container)
Broccoli florets — 350 g total (70 g per container)
Cauliflower — 400 g total (80 g per container)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season with salt, pepper, and half the paprika. Sear in the olive oil in batches, 4–5 min per side until browned. Remove.
In the same pan, cook the onion 2–3 min until soft. Stir in the remaining paprika, then the cream and parmesan. Simmer 3–4 min until the sauce thickens.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer 8–10 min until cooked through (175°F for thighs). Slice or leave whole.
Steam the broccoli 4–5 min until just tender (it keeps cooking when reheated). Rice the cauliflower raw or pulse in a processor.
Divide into 5 containers: cauliflower rice and broccoli on one side, chicken with plenty of sauce on the other. Reheat with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Tuna-Avocado Mason Jar (keto)
laineLunch.note: Standing cold tuna jar with the black beans swapped for egg, celery, cucumber, and avocado to fit keto. No reheating. Add the avocado fresh when you eat it so it doesn't brown.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans for 5)
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — 1 tbsp per jar (5 ½ tbsp for 5)
Celery — 30 g per jar (150 g for 5)
English cucumber — 40 g per jar (200 g for 5)
Avocado — 50 g per jar (250 g for 5)
Dijon mustard — 1 tsp per jar
Eggs — 1 egg per jar (5 eggs for 5)
Fresh herbs (parsley/dill/cilantro) — 2 g per jar

steps: Hard-boil 5 eggs (cook 10 min, cool in ice water). Dice the celery and cucumber.
Mix tuna, mayo, and Dijon per jar. Fold in the celery.
Layer each jar: tuna salad, cucumber, sliced hard-boiled egg, parsley. Keep the avocado whole until eating.
To eat: slice the avocado on top and mix, or eat it layered. Two sittings per jar if you like.

laineBreakfasts.name: Keto Berry-Pecan Parfait
laineBreakfasts.note: Full-fat Greek yogurt with a few raspberries and pecans.

ingredients.item: Greek yogurt (plain 5%) — 150 g
Raspberries — 25 g
Pecans — 15 g
Ground flaxseed — 6 g

steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl. Top with raspberries, pecans, and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble with Cheddar & Spinach

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites — 150 g
Eggs — 1 egg
Cheddar cheese — 20 g
Baby spinach — 30 g
Butter — 1 ¾ tsp

steps: Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low. Add the egg whites and whole egg(s); scramble gently.
Add the spinach at the end and wilt 30 seconds. Fold in the cheddar off the heat and serve.

laineBreakfasts.name: Almond-Flour Waffle + Raspberries
laineBreakfasts.note: Keto stand-in for Sunday's Birch Benders waffles (the regular mix doesn't fit 20 g net).

ingredients.item: Almond flour — 30 g
Eggs — 1 egg
Cream cheese — 1 tbsp
Butter — 1 ¾ tsp
Raspberries — 20 g
Greek yogurt (plain 5%) — 40 g

steps: Whisk almond flour, egg, softened cream cheese, and a pinch of baking powder and salt into a batter. Rest 3 min.
Cook in a preheated, buttered waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp. Top with raspberries and the yogurt dollop.

ingredients.item: Eggs — Jake 5 eggs, Laine 2 eggs
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Celery — Jake 30 g, Laine 25 g
